mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT g.GROUP_ID, g.TITLE AS GROUP_TITLE, g.STATUS AS GROUP_STATUS, g.OWNER_ID, g.ORDER_CONFIRMED_YN, gm.STATUS AS MEMBER_STATUS, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, gm.PAYOUT_RECEIVED_YN, TO_CHAR(gm.PAYOUT_RECEIVED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PAYOUT_RECEIVED_AT, pr.ROUND_NO AS CONFIRMED_ROUND_NO FROM GYE_GROUP g LEFT JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = #{targetMemberId} LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, MIN(ROUND_NO) AS ROUND_NO FROM PAYOUT_REQUEST WHERE STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID ) pr ON pr.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND pr.MEMBER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID WHERE g.GROUP_ID = #{groupId}

SELECT gm.MEMBER_ID, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, CASE WHEN g.OWNER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'MEMBER' END AS ROLE, pr.ROUND_NO AS CONFIRMED_ROUND_NO, gm.PAYOUT_RECEIVED_YN, TO_CHAR(gm.PAYOUT_RECEIVED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PAYOUT_RECEIVED_AT FROM GYE_MEMBER gm JOIN GYE_GROUP g ON g.GROUP_ID = gm.GROUP_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, MIN(ROUND_NO) AS ROUND_NO FROM PAYOUT_REQUEST WHERE STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID ) pr ON pr.GROUP_ID = gm.GROUP_ID AND pr.MEMBER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY pr.ROUND_NO ASC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN gm.MEMBER_ID = g.OWNER_ID THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, gm.JOINED_AT ASC, gm.GYE_MEMBER_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE GYE_MEMBER SET PAYOUT_RECEIVED_YN = 'Y', PAYOUT_RECEIVED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{targetMemberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND PAYOUT_RECEIVED_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_LOG_ID, GROUP_ID, ACTOR_MEMBER_ID, ACTOR_ADMIN_ID, TARGET_MEMBER_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{actorMemberId}, NULL, #{targetMemberId}, #{eventType}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
